ocl.definition: bookCopyNumSet:Set(Book) = Book.allInstance()->select(b | b.CallNo = callno), isUniqueCallNo:Boolean = bookCopyNumSet->isEmpty()
ocl.postcondition: let book:Book in book.oclIsNew() and Book.allInstance()->includes(book) and book.CallNo = callno and book.Title = title and book.Edition = edition and book.Author = author and book.Publisher = publisher and book.Description = description and book.ISBn = isbn and book.CopyNum = copynum and result = isUniqueCallNo
